key_concepts: Modern periodic table arranges elements by increasing atomic number
Elements with similar properties are placed in the same vertical column or group
The periodic table has 7 periods or rows and 18 groups or columns
Each element box shows atomic number, symbol, average atomic mass, and sometimes name
Transition elements are the B-group elements
Inner transition elements are the two rows below the main table
Metals are found on the left and center, nonmetals on the right, and metalloids along the
Some groups have common names such as alkali metals, chalcogens, noble gases, and lanthani
